text: You don’t need to sort anything out right now.
Feel the support beneath your body.
Let your breathing find an easy rhythm.
You might notice what is still moving through you.
There’s no need to change it.
Let your jaw have a little space.
Notice where your body meets the surface beneath you.
The conversation can stay unfinished for now.
Right now, you are here, in this room.
Let the music hold this quiet for a while.
If the words come back, you don’t have to answer them.
Softly begin to notice the room around you.
Gently move your fingers and toes.
Let your eyes open at your own pace.
Take the next part of your day slowly.
